subject: Private cloud incident response materials and SIG/CAIQ transfer for FinHealth
messages:
From: Security Team <security@finhealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Private Cloud IRP & SIG/CAIQ for upcoming audit

Hi Avery,

We are kicking off an audit readiness packet ahead of FinHealth's Q4 vendor security assessment and need your incident response materials for the private-cloud deployment that hosts our sandbox environment. Specifically we need: IRP (latest version), a short runbook describing detection & escalation for suspected data exfil events, and the SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet mapping for the services we consume.

Also please confirm evidence around:
- log retention windows and access audit trails for the private cluster
- forensics readiness (e.g., ability to export immutable logs)

Can we get these by EOD Wednesday (10/06)? If transfer needs to be on an approved channel please propose one (SFTP, SSO-protected SharePoint, presigned S3). Our security contact for coordination is Alice Morgan (alice.morgan@finhealth.com).

Thanks,
FinHealth Security
---
Attachments: none (initial request)

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Security Team <security@finhealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Private Cloud IRP & SIG/CAIQ for upcoming audit

Hi Alice / FinHealth Security team,

Thanks for the heads-up — we can provide the IRP and SIG/CAIQ mapping. Quick notes and options:

Transfer options (pick one):
- Secure SharePoint site (SSO enforced, recommended) — we can invite alice.morgan@finhealth.com and share a restricted folder.
- SFTP drop with short TTL credentials (we provide creds and remove after download).
- Presigned S3 links (HTTPS, time-limited).

Hannah (Security Ops) will package the IRP and the sanitized runbook. Rishi will include the logging/retention statement and CAIQ mapping. Priyom will coordinate the ticket and HubSpot record for traceability.

Can you confirm preferred transfer channel and whether screenshots need additional redaction (IPs, hostnames)? We will prepare the SIG baseline spreadsheet along with the mapping CSV. Target delivery EOD 10/05 if we use S3 or SharePoint; 10/06 if you need an internal approval cycle.

-Avery
Avery Johnson
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0146

Attachments: none

From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finhealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Chen <bob.chen@finhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Private Cloud IRP & SIG/CAIQ for upcoming audit

Thanks Avery — SharePoint SSO is preferable (we have existing SAML trust with Redwood). Please invite alice.morgan@finhealth.com and bob.chen@finhealth.com. Screenshots should be sanitized for internal hostnames and any customer identifiers; we do not need IPs.

A couple of clarifying items:
- Can you include a short statement (1 paragraph) confirming immutable log export capability and whether logs are retained off-node for at least 90 days?
- We need the SIG baseline XLS plus the CAIQ CSV with column mappings.

If possible include a one-page runbook excerpt that shows the first 30 minutes of escalation for suspected exfil.

Alice Morgan
Head of Vendor Risk, FinHealth
alice.morgan@finhealth.com

Attachments: none

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finhealth.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Packaging: IRP, runbook excerpt, SIG baseline and CAIQ mapping (FinHealth)

Hi Alice / team,

Per the request, we have prepared the following artifacts and placed them in a restricted SharePoint folder (SSO enforced). You should have an invite via SAML to: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/compliance/FinHealth/IRP_v3 (link below).

Delivered artifacts (sanitized where noted):
- IRP_v3.pdf — Full incident response plan (we redacted internal hostnames and non-customer UUIDs).
- ir_runbook_sanitized.pdf — 1-page excerpt showing the first 30 minutes of detection -> triage -> escalation (contains play-by-play with redactions).
- sig_baseline.xlsx — Completed SIG baseline for services used by FinHealth.
- caiq_mapping.csv — CAIQ column mapping and our responses for the private-cloud service footprint.

Short answers to your asks:
- Immutable export & retention: We provide immutable log export via append-only object storage and support presigned exports; default retention configuration for private cluster logs is 180 days (configurable), with exports available to authorized admins.
- Forensics readiness: We retain full audit logs for 180 days, have tamper-evident storage, and documented procedures for chain-of-custody exports.

Transfer details / evidence links:
- SharePoint (SSO + restricted): https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/compliance/FinHealth/IRP_v3
- Presigned S3 bucket (90-minute TTL): s3://redwood-secure-transfer/finhealth/2026-10-05/ (links in SharePoint folder)
- HubSpot ticket: HB-78291 (we will attach the SharePoint audit to this ticket for traceability)

Attachments referenced above are also linked in the SharePoint folder. Note: we redacted internal IPs/hostnames and customer identifiers where requested; if you need additional redaction please advise and we can regenerate.

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Security Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
---
Attachments: IRP_v3.pdf (pdf), ir_runbook_sanitized.pdf (pdf), sig_baseline.xlsx (xlsx), caiq_mapping.csv (csv)

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>

Alice — thanks, confirmed receipt of the SharePoint invite.

I'll schedule a 30-minute walkthrough for Friday 10/08 with Hannah and Rishi to go over the IRP excerpt and CAIQ mapping; calendar invite to follow. Priyom will close out HB-78291 and attach the audit trail of the transfer.

If you identify any gaps after your review, we will produce a redlined/annotated response and can follow with a short tabletop if helpful.

Best,
Avery
